info.name: AWS IoT Accept Certificate Transfer Violation Events#startTime&endTime API
Amazon IoT Device Defender List Violation Events

params.name: startTime
params.description: The start time for the alerts to be listed.

params.name: endTime
params.description: The end time for the alerts to be listed.

params.name: thingName
params.description: A filter to limit results to those alerts caused by the specified thing.

params.name: securityProfileName
params.description: A filter to limit results to those alerts generated by the specified security profile.

params.name: listSuppressedAlerts
params.description: A list of all suppressed alerts.

params.name: verificationState
params.description: The verification state of the violation (detect alarm).

params.name: nextToken
params.description: The token for the next set of results.

params.name: maxResults
params.description: The maximum number of results to return at one time.

items.docs:
Lists the Device Defender security profile violations discovered during the given time period. You can use filters to limit the results to those alerts issued for a particular security profile, behavior, or thing (device).

Requires permission to access the ListViolationEvents action.
